summary: The StudentEmploymentApplication is a web form for students to apply for employment, capturing student, program, and site information, supporting document uploads, and enabling submission and placement history release with staff/recruitment notifications.
purpose: Facilitate student employment applications, collect relevant details and documents, allow students to release their placement history to sites, provide status messages, and notify recruitment contacts upon submission.

workflows.name: Employment Application Submission
steps: Student accesses the application form, optionally via ID in query string.
Screen loads: validates URL hash, retrieves EmploymentApplication by ID.
Header form displays student, program, site info.
Document tab: student uploads supporting documents.
Placement History tab: student manages release of placement history.
Student can submit the application if screen is editable.
On submit: triggers EmploymentApplications.Submit, optionally releases history.
If successful and recruitment contact email exists: email notification sent using templates.
Warnings or errors shown if no recruitment contact or email fails.

workflows.name: Document Management
steps: Student uploads/selects documents via UCDocument/UCDocumentSelector controls.
Document controls are linked only if the Documents tab is active.

workflows.name: Placement History Release
steps: Student checks 'Release My Placement History To Site'.
UCPlacementHistory panel enabled when release is requested or editable.
Placement history data is bound and made visible.

workflows.name: Error/Warning Panel Handling
steps: Panels show error or warning messages as needed.

business_rules: Screen is editable only if application is not withdrawn and student is owner or a system administrator.
Submit button visible only for owner or system administrator.
Placement history panel visible if release history is enabled or screen is editable.
Recruitment contact email notification sent only if email is present.
Display warnings if recruitment contact email is missing.
validations: URL hash validated on page load.
Form view bound only if employment application data found.
Email presence validated before sending notification.
calculations: ScreenIsEditable is computed based on WithdrawnDate and user role.
conditions: TabContainer controls visibility of document and placement history panels.
Read-only mode enforced if WithdrawnDate is set.
UCPlacementHistory enabled only if ReleaseHistory is true.
system_behavior: On Page_Load: sets up page, binds data, manages control visibility and active tabs.
On cmdSubmit_Click: submits application, sends email if conditions met, updates messages.
On fvwHeader_DataBound: enables email link if email present.
On Page_PreRender: processes messages and resizes window.
Controls visibility and binding of document selectors based on active tab.
dependencies: HSPnet.UserControls for document and history panels.
exceptions: No recruitment contact email: warning is shown, no email sent.
content_gaps: Details of field-level validation (e.g., input types, required/optional) are not fully specified.
Exact email template fields are not shown.
Full list of employment application fields is not available; only visible fields are extracted.
